title: Yes! He said he's coming to my house!
scene: 朋友说来家里玩，时间没定死。

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Did you talk to Leo at school today?

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Yes! He said he's coming to my house!

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Oh nice! Did he say which day?

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: He said maybe Saturday, if his mom says yes.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Then let's hope Mom says yes! What will you play?

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: He said he'll bring his big yellow truck!

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Then we should tidy the toy room, just in case.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Yes! Let's tidy it right now!

variations: "Leo" 换 "Mia"；"big yellow truck" 换 "new doll"。
